high_level_description: This image captures a lively and festive moment during the Holi festival, a vibrant Hindu celebration of colors. The central figure is a woman standing outdoors, her hands and face smeared with bright pink powder, symbolizing the playful and joyous nature of Holi. She is wearing a white dress that is also splattered with the same pink powder, indicating she has been actively participating in the festivities. The background shows a grassy area with some people standing around, suggesting an outdoor gathering or celebration.
